result.rationale: Confirmed in the diff: addGuests.handler.ts computes `uniqueGuests` (filtering out already-attendees) but then calls `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` passing the raw input array, not `uniqueGuests`. In email-manager.ts, `sendAddGuestsEmails` sends `AttendeeScheduledEmail` when `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)`, so an existing attendee whose email was included in the request (but silently filtered from being added) receives a 'your event has been scheduled' email instead of the add-guests notice. Mechanism fully verifiable from the diff.

judged_text: `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` passes the raw request array instead of `uniqueGuests`, so the email-manager's `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` check (email-manager.ts line 541) matches emails that were filtered out and never added. When the request contains an already-attendee's email (silently dropped by the uniqueGuests filter), that existing attendee receives the full AttendeeScheduledEmail 'your event has been scheduled' email instead of the AttendeeAddGuestsEmail notice — a wrong, confusing email for an event they booked long ago.
